snippet.title: Ghost in the Shell PS1 Intro - High Quality
snippet.description: This is a high quality capture of the Ghost in the Shell intro PlayStation game intro from a making-of laserdisc. Ironically, the laserdisc is probably the highest quality version of the intro out there!
